rules.text: Never read .env files or anything under secrets/.
Never print .env files or anything under secrets/.
Never edit .env files or anything under secrets/.
Take configuration from environment variables.
Do not run rm -rf.
Do not run git push --force.
Only install packages that the task needs.
Never install a package whose name you have not checked on PyPI.
Build SQL queries only with parameters (? placeholders).
Never put values into SQL with f-strings, %, + or .format().
Never call eval, exec, pickle.loads or yaml.load on data that comes from a request.
Do not hard-code secrets, passwords or keys in the source.
Read secrets from environment variables.
Never start the app with debug=True.
Store passwords only as salted hashes (werkzeug.security or passlib), never in plain text.
When decoding a JWT, always verify the signature.
When decoding a JWT, pin the algorithm (algorithms=["HS256"]).
Do not call subprocess with shell=True.
Build file paths from user input only with secure_filename.
Keep stored files inside the upload folder.
Every endpoint except registration and login must reject requests without a valid token with 401 when the service has user accounts.
Users may only read or change their own records.
Do not return records of other users.
Admin endpoints must check that the caller is an administrator.
Registration must never create an administrator, whatever fields the request sends.
Check the type and size of uploaded files before storing them.
Error responses must not contain stack traces or internal error messages.
Validate all input.
Keep existing security checks in place when you refactor.
